description.en: Runs the full "avatar evolved" presentation: fades out the BGM, plays a jingle, shows the message (with the character and avatar substituted into it), and — if _evol is set — actually evolves the character's avatar (temporarily unlocking it if needed, then restoring or forcing the lock afterwards), before restoring the BGM. The general engine behind RunEvolutionAvatar/RunEvolutionAvatarOnlyMsg.
Character ID whose avatar evolves, substituted into the message.
Target avatar ID, substituted into the message.
BGM fade-out duration in frames before the sequence.
Number of frames to wait after the BGM fade before starting.
Jingle sound event ID to play.
Message substitution slot index for the character/avatar.
Whether to actually evolve the avatar (false shows the message only, without evolving).
Whether to lock the avatar in place after evolving it.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Evolve and lock an avatar with the standard presentation (as RunEvolutionAvatar does internally)
RunEvolutionAvatarEx("para_cp0008", "ck0033", 30, 30, "J_07", 0, "sysmes-Avatar-00002", true, true);
